caption:
Two clinics, one team: Chatswood and the Sydney CBD.

Chatswood (Level 1, 38B Albert Ave) is a short walk from Chatswood station, handy if you live on the North Shore or work nearby. Sydney CBD (Suite 1102, 99 York St) is a short walk from Wynyard, so it suits people fitting an appointment around a city workday.

Our physiotherapists, chiropractors, clinical Pilates team and remedial massage therapists work as one team, talking to each other and referring between services when that suits your goals. We see people under Medicare's chronic condition management plan, NSW WorkCover, NSW CTP, NDIS and DVA.

Choose the clinic that suits you, then pick a practitioner and time. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
